title: Rolling Calibration Windows for Seasonal Drift Adaptation
expected_improvement: 0.003-0.008 Brier reduction (based on lit: LR achieves 0.199 vs XGBoost 0.202)
motivation: Academic SOTA for NBA Brier is 0.199 (LR + isotonic calibration). Our best is 0.21854. Gap of ~0.019. Research shows NBA team dynamics shift mid-season (fatigue, trades, playoff seeding dynamics). Calibrating on full history smears early-season patterns into late-season predictions.
description: Instead of fitting the calibrator (isotonic / Venn-Abers) on the full training set, apply a recency-weighted calibration: fit on the most recent N games only. This allows the calibration to adapt to current-season team quality and rest patterns rather than being dominated by old data.

approach: 1. During evaluate_individual(), after XGB/ET/LGB prediction, collect (prob, outcome) pairs
2. Sort by game_date, take last 500 games for calibration fit (vs current: all ~9551)
3. Apply isotonic regression on rolling window only
4. Compare Brier on holdout (last 200 games) vs full-window calibration
5. Add ROLLING_CAL_WINDOW as a GA-tunable parameter (200, 500, 1000, 2000, all)
implementation.ga_integration: Add rolling_cal_window to individual genome (new gene slot). Values: [200, 500, 1000, 2000, 9999(=all)]. Crossover/mutate like n_features.
implementation.rollout: Deploy to S10 only first, measure Brier delta over 20 generations, then fleet-wide

supporting_evidence: MDPI 2026: 'Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting' — recurrent + MC dropout with rolling state achieves calibrated sequential probabilities
Nature 2025 stacked ensemble paper: best base learner (LR) Brier=0.199 vs XGBoost=0.202 — suggests calibration gap is larger than model gap
Current engine uses Venn-Abers on full set — already good, but seasonal drift not addressed
NBA mid-season trades (deadline Feb 2026) create distribution shift in team compositions
risk: LOW — calibration is post-hoc, does not affect feature engineering or model weights. Easy to A/B test and revert.
cross_project_applicability: MEDIUM — political engine has only ~1180 events (too few for rolling window to help). Flag for when political dataset grows to >5000 events.
follow_up: After validation: port rolling_cal_window gene to all 6 NBA islands
Explore adaptive window based on regime detection (pre/post All-Star, playoff push, etc.)
